lines.text: Planners say they will spend a year in a city doing business, yet they do not know tomorrow.
James says life is a mist, so people ought to say, "If the Lord is willing."
James calls their boasting good, and says knowing the right thing yet not doing it is sin.
James tells the rich to weep over coming misery, and says locusts have eaten their clothes.
The withheld wages of the workmen cry out, and the rich have condemned and murdered the righteous.
